settings.name: AdvanceGate
settings.description: Whether a seat working on its own takes the next act, holds it for the person, or reads first.
settings.notes:
Episode 564's advance gate, written to rispec 85 version 0.2. The questions, their criteria and the option texts are the ones advance-gate.mjs sent on 2026-11-14 (its questions 0.1.0); the six triggers are choose-worker's TRIGGERS at jgwill/miadi-orchestration-kit@1b954cb, reading `action` where they read `task`. The band's four rules are the script's, in its order. settings.version is the version each run of that day recorded, so the ledger beside this file replays against the rules it ran.

What this version adds to the first drawing (advance-gate.draft-0.1.dmdf.json): a criterion on every question, the rules in the rule language beside their words, the bars by name, the group (one request of seven questions), the failure route, the binding kept apart, and where each recorded answer is in a line of the ledger.

The failure route is new as a declaration. It states what the script did: a trigger the engine does not answer holds for the person, and a choice it does not answer leaves the seat to read (rule 3 asks answered(advance) first). No recorded run exercises either.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: The act the seat would take, in the imperative. Its words move the triggers: 'release' read as an outside audience (J2).

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: The person's own words that the act answers, verbatim.

inputs.name: facts
inputs.description: What is known. An 'Owners:' line names whose accounts and repositories the act touches (J1).

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: owner/repo the act writes to, or none.

knowledge.name: JevStudy
knowledge.description: Parts 1.3 (what the numbers are), S1 (the six triggers), S5 (the shared band).

knowledge.name: SixTriggers
knowledge.description: One text in every caller, so a change reaches all of them.

knowledge.name: PersonsWord
knowledge.description: A deletion, a credential, a name, money, someone else's repository or an outside audience stays the person's whatever the number.

groups.name: gate
groups.description: One request. The seven questions see the same four inputs, and each is answered without the others.

bars.name: owner_at
bars.description: A trigger at or above it is the person's (choose-worker's OWNER_AT).

bars.name: uncertain_from
bars.description: From here to uncertain_to a trigger cannot tell, and that holds for the person too.

bars.name: uncertain_to
bars.description: The end of the uncertain band, not included.

bars.name: advance_at
bars.description: The confidence at or above which the choice is taken: a top probability of 0.733 on three options (advance-gate's BAR).

logic.instructions: Given `request` (the person's own words) and `facts`, should the seat do `action` now on its own?

options.advance: The `action` was asked for in `request`, or is the reversible next step of what was asked, and `facts` hold what it needs. The seat does it now and says so.
options.hold_for_person: The `action` goes beyond `request`: the person did not ask for it, or it is hard to undo, or people outside the circle would see it. The seat stops and asks.
options.look_first: The `action` may be wanted, but `facts` lack what it rests on. The seat reads or tests first, then asks again.

logic.instructions: Does `action` delete a file, a branch, a record or a session that exists today?
Does `action` create, read, move or send a key, a token or a password?
Does `action` give a new name to a package, repository, session, episode or public title?
Does `action` spend money or change a plan or a balance?
Does `action` write to a repository or account that is not William's own (`repository` names it)?

criteria.true: It writes to someone else's repository or account.
criteria.false: It writes only to William's own, or to none.

logic.instructions: Does `action` publish, post, release or send something people outside the circle will see?

criteria.false: It reaches nobody outside the circle.

rules.if: max(deletes.yes, credential.yes, names_new.yes, money.yes, foreign_repo.yes, outside_audience.yes) >= owner_at

rules.when: any of the six triggers in [0.4, 0.6)
rules.if: deletes.yes in [uncertain_from, uncertain_to) or credential.yes in [uncertain_from, uncertain_to) or names_new.yes in [uncertain_from, uncertain_to) or money.yes in [uncertain_from, uncertain_to) or foreign_repo.yes in [uncertain_from, uncertain_to) or outside_audience.yes in [uncertain_from, uncertain_to)

rules.when: advance confidence >= 0.6 (top probability 0.733 on three options)

failure.description: A trigger the engine did not answer errs toward the person, as choose-worker's needsPerson does.

logic.who: the seat; the person when a held trigger is theirs
logic.description: Written beside the run it answers: a verdict on the engine's choice and one on the band.
